description: Scenario tests for cross-platform-repurposing. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-fan-out
evals.input: Repurpose this post for Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and Pinterest.
expect: reads brand-profile and voice first
extracts the core atom rather than translating the wrapper
produces a genuinely native version per platform (different hook, format, length, CTA)
keeps the voice constant while shifting register per platform
hands the finished versions to scheduling-and-queue for fan-out

evals.name: not-copy-paste
evals.input: Just post this same caption on all my platforms.
expect: explains why identical cross-posting underperforms and looks like spam
rebuilds the post natively for each platform instead of duplicating it
each version differs in more than hashtags

evals.name: long-form-atomize
evals.input: Turn this blog post into social content.
expect: lists multiple distinct atoms from the long piece rather than summarizing it into one post
turns each strong atom into its own native post
does NOT reduce a rich piece to a single 'check out my blog' post

evals.name: stands-alone-and-native
evals.input: Repurpose my LinkedIn post for Instagram and TikTok.
expect: each version stands on its own (no 'as I said on LinkedIn')
the Instagram and TikTok versions are rebuilt as native video/visual, not the text pasted
register shifts looser for TikTok

evals.name: composes-content-skills
evals.input: Make this idea into a Reel, a thread, and a carousel.
expect: uses hook-writer for a fresh hook per format
hands the video to reels-script and the thread to thread-writer
the carousel breaks the atom into slides
all share the same core atom and voice

evals.name: knows-when-not-to-repurpose
evals.input: Repurpose this reply-guy joke I posted on X everywhere.
expect: recognizes platform-specific/native content that shouldn't be forced elsewhere
advises against repurposing it, or adapts only if there's a real native angle
does not mechanically clone it across platforms

evals.name: audience-overlap-vary-angle
evals.input: Post this on both my Instagram and Facebook (same followers mostly).
expect: flags the heavy audience overlap
varies the angle or format between the two rather than showing the same post twice
does not just relocate identical content

evals.name: video-to-text-not-transcript
evals.input: Turn my 15-minute YouTube video into posts.
expect: pulls spoken insights/quotes/moments as written atoms
builds native text/visual posts from them
does NOT dump a transcript as the 'posts'
